annotations.title: 4K RGB Camera
annotations.text: Records 4K video at 30 fps for sharp, detailed inspection footage.

annotations.title: LiDAR
annotations.text: Captures 200,000 points per second with 2 cm precision over a 40 m range, for accurate mapping of the environment.

annotations.title: Battery
annotations.text: A 6S 6,000 mAh battery delivers more than 10 minutes of flight time.

annotations.title: 10,000-Lumen Lighting
annotations.text: 10,000 lumens to light up dark spaces, with intelligent modes: full, dust and oblique.

annotations.title: Data Extraction
annotations.text: A combined LiDAR and data connector using 100/1000 Ethernet for fast transfer of captured data.

annotations.title: On/Off Button
annotations.text: Turns the drone on and off.

annotations.title: Protective Elements
annotations.text: Resistant to side and vertical impacts, keeping the drone protected when flying close to structures.

annotations.title: Protective Handle
annotations.text: Lets you pick up and carry the drone safely.

annotations.title: 1D Laser
annotations.text: A single laser beam that measures the distance to the surface in front of the camera.

annotations.title: Gimbal Module
annotations.text: Tilts the cameras from -90° to +90°, so they can look straight down, straight ahead or straight up.

annotations.title: Indicator Light
annotations.text: Shows the drone's status at a glance.
